prompt: give me a top end pc build with unlimited budget, the build should include all the components
response: With an unlimited budget, you'd want the absolute top-of-the-line components. Start with an Intel Core i9-13900K processor, paired with a high-end motherboard like the ASUS ROG Maximus Z690 Extreme. Add 64GB of DDR5 RAM, and a top-tier graphics card like the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090. For storage, a 4TB NVMe SSD will suffice. A high-end liquid cooler and a powerful PSU complete the build.
